title: l1qw.32(c): group-mode encrypted beacons to ff35 group multicast (needs group OSCORE)
description: Largest slice of worker6-l1qw.32 (spec 18.2.4): in group mode position beacons must be ENCRYPTED with the group OSCORE key and sent to the ff35 group multicast — today group mode merely suppresses beacons (coap_location.c:576-577; suppression test lichen/tests/coap_location_beacon/main.c:373-398) and no ff35 encrypted beacon exists anywhere. Depends on group-OSCORE send/recv plumbing (see worker6-2h1i.2.8 family / OSCORE group context work — human-only per repo policy) — do NOT start without that landing; file the dependency to Mark if group keys remain unprovisioned.
